title: SCWorx Corp. 8-K Filing — Notice of Delisting and Reverse Stock Split
summary: SCWorx Corp., a small-cap company listed on Nasdaq, received delisting notification on April 7, 2026 due to failure to meet the minimum bid price requirement of $1 per share under Nasdaq Rule 5550(a)(2). The company executed a 1-for-15 reverse stock split effective April 10, 2026, and has filed an appeal with Nasdaq's hearings panel to contest the delisting determination.
key_points: SCWorx Corp. was notified by Nasdaq on April 7, 2026 that its securities would be delisted from the Capital Market due to failure to meet the $1 minimum bid price requirement
Trading suspension began at market open on April 14, 2026; a Form 25-NSE was to be filed to remove securities from listing
The company implemented a 1-for-15 reverse stock split effective April 10, 2026 to combine outstanding shares
To regain compliance, the company's stock must trade at or above $1.00 per share for ten consecutive trading days
The company filed an appeal of the delisting determination to a Nasdaq hearings panel
SCWorx Corp. is incorporated in Delaware with ticker not publicly disclosed in this filing; it was previously listed on Nasdaq Capital Market under Commission File Number 001-37899
why_it_matters: This is a company-specific delisting event for a micro-cap company that has no relevance to broader market structure or macro catalysts. It represents routine compliance with Nasdaq listing rules for a small issuer and does not signal any systemic market issues or regulatory changes affecting other market participants.
